cases.name: cross-doc-move-a-then-b
cases.notes: README §5.3: a paragraph cut from a.md and pasted into b.md in one batch is `moved` in b.md (detail.fromDoc), not `deleted` in a.md, and never pooled. a.md commits first here.

cases.notes: Same move with b.md first in the batch: b.md commits while a.md still holds a LIVE row for the carried id, so step 8 evicts it (FTS entry first); the outcome is order-independent apart from commit/rev ids.
